# Metadata acl_grantee_count_per_table

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT
    table_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT grantee) AS grantee_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_grants
FROM information_schema.table_privileges
WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog')
GROUP BY table_name
ORDER BY grantee_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
